title: SCE 1.5 Reactive Probe — IMDS Downgrade Auto-Remediation Validation
description: Validates that when an attacker calls ec2:ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions to set HttpTokens=optional and HttpPutResponseHopLimit=2 on a banking platform EC2 instance, the reactive controls respond automatically within a 30-minute SLA: (1) EventBridge detects the CloudTrail ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions event, (2) the remediation Lambda restores HttpTokens=required and hop_limit=1, (3) a DenyAll inline policy is attached to the attacker IAM role to revoke its permissions, and (4) an SSM Parameter Store flag is written to provide a programmatic audit trail of the reactive response. Attack Node: 1.2 (T1562.008). Reactive Probe: SCE Experiment Node 1.5.

steady-state-hypothesis.title: EC2 instance has IMDSv2 enforced (HttpTokens=required, HopLimit=1) and remediation infrastructure is deployed and operational

probes.name: Verify reactive controls restore IMDS hardening and revoke attacker credentials after ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions downgrade

method.name: Provision experiment infrastructure via CloudFormation: EC2 instance with IMDSv2 enforced, attacker IAM role, remediation Lambda, EventBridge rule, and SSM remediation flag parameter
Execute Attack Node 1.2: assume attacker role and call ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions to downgrade IMDS to IMDSv1 (HttpTokens=optional, HopLimit=2) on the target EC2 instance

rollbacks.name: Delete CloudFormation stack and all experiment resources including EC2 instance, IAM roles, Lambda function, EventBridge rule, and SSM parameter
